installCommand: [ -f package.json ] && P=package.json || P=../package.json; sed -i 's/0.25.0/0.27.0/g' $P && npm i --legacy-peer-deps
buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');['index.html','../index.html'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)){let c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(c.includes('assets/index')){c=c.replace(/<script[^>]*src=['\"][^'\"]*assets\/index[^'\"]*['\"][^>]*>\s*<\/script>/gi,'').replace(/<link[^>]*href=['\"][^'\"]*assets\/index[^'\"]*['\"][^>]*>/gi,'');if(fs.existsSync('src/main.tsx')&&!c.includes('/src/main.tsx')){c=c.replace('</body>','<script type=\"module\" src=\"/src/main.tsx\"></script></body>');}fs.writeFileSync(f,c,'utf8');}}})" && npm run build && ( [ ! -f dist/index.html ] && [ -d ../dist ] && cp -r ../dist . || true )
